title: Proffitt & Goodson Inc. Sells 815 Shares of Apple Inc. (AAPL)
text:
Proffitt & Goodson Inc. lessened its holdings in shares of Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 7.7% during the 2nd quarter, according to its most recent 13F filing with the SEC. The institutional investor owned 9,808 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after selling 815 shares during the period. Apple accounts for approximately 0.8% of Proffitt & Goodson Inc.’s investment portfolio, making the stock its 10th biggest holding. Proffitt & Goodson Inc.’s holdings in Apple were worth $1,816,000 as of its most recent SEC filing.
Several other hedge funds and other institutional investors have also modified their holdings of the company. Jag Capital Management LLC raised its position in shares of Apple by 2.6% during the 2nd quarter. Jag Capital Management LLC now owns 21,094 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $3,905,000 after acquiring an additional 532 shares in the last quarter. MCF Advisors LLC raised its position in shares of Apple by 107.5% during the 2nd quarter. MCF Advisors LLC now owns 25,327 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $4,476,000 after acquiring an additional 13,119 shares in the last quarter. Whittier Trust Co. raised its position in shares of Apple by 2.2% during the 2nd quarter. Whittier Trust Co. now owns 403,706 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $37,517,000 after acquiring an additional 8,538 shares in the last quarter. First Command Bank raised its position in shares of Apple by 118.4% during the 2nd quarter. First Command Bank now owns 17,819 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $3,298,000 after acquiring an additional 9,660 shares in the last quarter. Finally, Cornerstone Wealth Management LLC increased its position in Apple by 18,553.3% during the second quarter. Cornerstone Wealth Management LLC now owns 16,758,709 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $89,526,000 after buying an additional 16,668,866 shares during the period. 58.61% of the stock is currently owned by institutional investors and hedge funds. Shares of AAPL stock opened at $219.31 on Monday. Apple Inc. has a twelve month low of $150.24 and a twelve month high of $233.47. The company has a market capitalization of $1,077.94 billion, a price-to-earnings ratio of 23.81, a P/E/G ratio of 1.69 and a beta of 1.36. The company has a current ratio of 1.31, a quick ratio of 1.24 and a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.84.
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last announced its earnings results on Tuesday, July 31st. The iPhone maker reported $2.34 earnings per share for the quarter, beating the consensus estimate of $2.18 by $0.16. Apple had a return on equity of 43.50% and a net margin of 21.98%. The company had revenue of $53.27 billion for the quarter, compared to the consensus estimate of $52.43 billion. During the same period last year, the business posted $1.67 EPS. The company’s revenue was up 17.3% on a year-over-year basis. On average, equities analysts expect that Apple Inc. will post 11.76 EPS for the current year.

Several research analysts have commented on the company. Wedbush assumed coverage on Apple in a research report on Thursday. They set an “outperform” rating and a $310.00 price target on the stock. JPMorgan Chase & Co. reaffirmed a “buy” rating and set a $272.00 price target on shares of Apple in a research report on Wednesday, October 10th. Bank of America reaffirmed a “buy” rating on shares of Apple in a research report on Tuesday, October 9th. Vertical Group assumed coverage on Apple in a research report on Tuesday, October 9th. They set a “sell” rating on the stock. Finally, UBS Group set a $250.00 price target on Apple and gave the stock a “buy” rating in a research report on Monday, October 8th. Three investment analysts have rated the stock with a sell rating, nineteen have assigned a hold rating and thirty have assigned a buy rating to the company. Apple currently has an average rating of “Buy” and an average target price of $224.63.
Apple Profile
Apple Inc designs, manufactures, and markets mobile communication and media devices, and personal computers to consumers, and small and mid-sized businesses; and education, enterprise, and government customers worldwide. The company also sells related software, services, accessories, networking solutions, and third-party digital content and applications.
